title: Prelaunch scan results
description: One result per scanned site, a run summary, and screenshots from full scans.

results.title: Scan results
results.description: One item per URL: grade, score, launch-ready flag, blocker/warning/info counts, per-check outcomes and every finding with its fix. URLs that couldn't be scanned have status "error".

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: How many sites were scanned, launch-ready, not ready, errored, or skipped at the spending limit.

files.title: Screenshots and files
files.description: Desktop, tablet and mobile screenshots saved by full scans.
